Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 36

“Even if you were the most sinful of all sinners, you would cross over all wickedness by the raft of knowledge alone.”

Krishna states the extreme case deliberately. The raft image keeps the claim modest — knowledge does not drain the water, it carries someone across it.
